scope: Read-only mathematical audit of CKAD20 frozen synthetic evaluation protocol, not CKAD20 implementation or a competing learner.
question: Can a >=0.02 paired reward lift across three seeds with 96 held episodes per seed establish scientific evidence of intervention value?

method.independence_unit: Seed-cluster, accounting for shared training and adaptive episodes within seed.
method.exact_test: Enumerate 2^3 paired sign flips of within-seed mean reward differences and compute two-sided P(abs(flipped_mean)>=abs(observed_mean)).
method.min_p_bound: With three independent nonzero seed clusters, exact two-sided p>=0.25, regardless of reward effect.
method.sample_sensitivity: At delta=.02 and discordance fraction q, approximate n80=ceil((z.975+z.80)^2*(q-delta^2)/delta^2). This is planning sensitivity, not observed variance.
method.strict_custody: Both policies actually executed on the same exogenous episode draw with separate action receipts and observed binary rewards. Reject imputation, duplicates and mixed cohorts.

negative_controls: Perfect favorable scores still cannot achieve seed-cluster p<0.05
Adversarial seed can cancel pooled improvement
success: Independently validate minimum p, sample sensitivity, and evidence-schema negative controls. Do not retroactively change CKAD20 frozen criteria or claim it executed.
authority: Separate isolated research branch. No source/controller/runner/scheduler change, accepted-main edit, merge, protected-first-use, original source actions or paid APIs.
